markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Handhold
markers.note: The only fixed point. Let go and you drift.

markers.name: INT_Gravity_Well_Switch
markers.note: Reverses which way is down for everyone in the region.

markers.name: INT_The_Long_Rope
markers.note: Tied at one end. The other end is not visible.

markers.name: INT_The_Slow_Clock
markers.note: Time near it runs at a third speed. Useful in a fight, awkward in a conversation.

markers.name: INT_The_Echo
markers.note: Repeats what you said, correctly, in a voice that is not yours.

markers.name: INT_The_Tether_Ring
markers.note: Two players tethered can reach islands neither could alone.

markers.name: INT_Black_Marble
markers.note: Weighs more than the island it is sitting on.

markers.name: INT_The_Silent_Bell
markers.note: No sound. Everyone in the reality feels it.

markers.name: INT_Time_Shard_Rift
markers.note: Yields the Time Shard (Reality class). Costs something.
